claim_text: The original September 13, 2022 indictment in United States v. Qamar Ahmed Hassan et al., No. 0:22-cr-00224 (ECF 1), charges Count 1 conspiracy to commit wire fraud in violation of 18 U.S.C. §§ 371 and 1343. It does not charge Count 1 under 18 U.S.C. § 1349.

supporting_passages.quote: in violation of Title 18, United States Code, Sections 371 and 1343

qualifiers: do not generalize absence of § 1349 to charging instruments not yet checked
